title: Reports endpoint (request and response shapes)
description: Schemas for POST /api/reports. Only ReportType=Period is implemented in this feature; IsoWeek is a documented future value of the enum but its strategy is not yet registered (the endpoint returns 400 for it). Status-code behavior is documented in http-endpoints.md.

ReportType.description: Open enum on the wire. Only Period resolves to a strategy in this feature; IsoWeek returns 400.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound. The strategy treats this as [start 00:00:00] against each transaction's timestamp.

end.description: Inclusive upper bound. The strategy treats this as [end 23:59:59]. Must satisfy start <= end.

data.description: Per-type payload. For type=Period the shape is PeriodReportData. Future report types document their own data shape.

total.description: SIGNED. Positive = income-side; negative = expense-side. No separate direction field. No transaction count.

period.description: Resolved coverage descriptor. For type=Period: 'yyyy-MM-dd..yyyy-MM-dd'. Future report types document their own descriptor format.

incomeTotal.description: Sum of Income-direction amounts in the window. Positive-or-zero.

expenseTotal.description: Sum of Expense-direction amounts in the window. Positive-or-zero.

categoryBreakdown.description: Sorted income-first (total >= 0; zero-total Both categories sort here), then expense-side (total < 0); alphabetical within each group. Multi-category transactions contribute full signed amount to EACH attached category line.
